nom: Clinique Clarifying Face Lotion 1.0 Twice A Day Exfoliator

avis.texte: I was told to use an exfoliater and I didn't like the ones that felt like sandpaper. Bought this and my skin looked better in 2 days! Love the feel of it!

Over the years i have used Clinique Clarifying Lotions #1 #2, and #3. They did the the job, there was nothing special about them. First day of using this product i noticed a difference when I washed my face that night. It was softer snd smoother. It had taken away the bumpy feel i have under the skin on my jawline. I love the feel of my skin again. Im amazed when i wash my face at how easily my fingers glide over my skin. I also have sensitive skin and this doesnt dry or irritate it. I love this stuff!!! Some things to note frim other reviewers, Claryifing Lotion isnt meant to remove your makeup. If there's makeup left on the cotton pad after using this, your makeuo remover isnt doing its job. Also some mentioned the smell. It smells lije it's ingredients. Clinique doesnt add fragrance to their products.

Over the years i have used Clinique Clarifying Lotions #1 #2, and #3. They did the the job, there was nothing special about them. First day of using this product i noticed a difference when I washed my face that night. It was softer snd smoother. It had taken away the bumpy feel i have under the skin on my jawline. I love the feel of my skin again. Im amazed when i wash my face at how easily my fingers glide over my skin. I also have sensitive skin and this doesnt dry or irritate it. I love this stuff!!! Some things to note frim other reviewers, Claryifing Lotion isnt meant to remove your makeup. If there's makeup left on the cotton pad after using this, your makeuo remover isnt doing its job. Also some mentioned the smell. It smells lije it's ingredients. Clinique doesnt add fragrance to their products.

After years of using Clinique's "other" alcohol laden toners, I had enough and decided to give this product a try. Wow! An immediate improvement in irritation, filaments and a healthy glow. I highly recommend this toner for those individuals who have mature skin.
Great product. Cleanses perfectly after washing your face. Leaves skin feeling fantastic.

This exfoliating lotion makes my skin glow. Sometimes I use only this in the morning. It almost makes my skin feel more moisturized. I have extremely sensitive, yet oily, skin. I'm so glad I tried this product.

This is the only Clarifying lotion that I can use from Clinique. It is very gentle and comforting on my skin without making it dry and tight like the other lotions that have alcohol in them. However, this particular clarifying lotion exfoliates my skin gently and perfectly, keeping it very healthy. I took advantage of the 30% friends and family sale and I bought the larger size.

avis.titre: 1.0 is the best for sensitive, dry skin
avis.texte: I have been using 1 or 2 or the men's version for years and always struggled with dryness and redness. I'm a man with sensitive, very dry skin. 1.0 is the solution! My face has never felt better. Finally it feels balanced, not too dry, not too oil, no redness, no itchiness. 1.0 is the magic. This is part of a full routine and using 1.0 has made my skin so much healthier. It may not be for everyone. I've tried many of their "lotions" and exfoliants, and this is the best for me. You have to try a few to find the right now for your skin; which can also change over time.

When I used this for the very first time, it made my skin burn and sting, and created multiple red spots on my (previously) clear skin. For the week that followed, I stopped using it, and despite that, every time I applied moisturiser, it would sting, due to my heavily compromised skin barrier. Disappointment. My skin was ruined.
I like this product , it is not so dry, has a very good cleaning and moisturizing properties!

I had struggled with acne since my teens. I had the ugly boils that were under the skin awful. I tried everything even accurate nothing worked. One day on vacation I went into ulta for mascara and a Clinique lady came up to me and asked if she could show me a picture it was a girl with acne like mine and she said Clinique helped me her skin was beautiful. She showed me this and the gentle foam cleanser I no longer have acne issues I love this.
This exfoliating lotion is gentle yet effective. Perfect for my dry, sensitive skin. It leaves my skin feeling smooth and refreshed without irritation. Great for daily use!

I purchased it online. The product smelled fermented, like yogurt. After using it, I had breakouts all over my face. I have purchased and used this product a year ago and 01 worked best for my skin in the clarifying series. At first, I thought the ingredients have changed, but after getting serious reaction on my skin, I knew there is something wrong with the product. I ended up going to the dermatologist and paid over $700 for the ointments afterwards. I don't know if the product I received was happened to have a issues, but now I am scared to buy it at least online again and would never reccoment to anyone.

I have sensitive skin. Everything makes it react. For awhile I stopped using any clarifying lotion due to irritation. But then my skin missed that aaah feeling it gets when you apply it with a cotton ball. I prefer 1 but 1.0 is gentler so I use both on and off

I just received this toner in my last order. I had been using it sparingly (once a day) for about a week. I always followed it with an application of Redness Solutions Daily Relief Cream. I woke up one morning and my face felt hot and itchy. I checked the mirror and I have a large, noticeable raised, red patch that feels bumpy and hot. I stopped using all products on my face and only rinsed with cold, filtered water. It has been 3 days and there has been no improvement.

I have extremely dry and sensitive skin and this is the only toner/exfoliator tgat has ever worked for my skin. It preps my skin great fir makeup and I even use it on my clients when I do a makeover because its the only thing that will help with patchiness.

This product is formulated with so many ingredients that are beneficial for skin. My only challenge with it is the witch hazel because it irritates my dry sensitive skin. At age 70 my skin barrier is not as healthy as it could be, so it's easy for irritation to occur. There are many other Clinique products I am using that do help me, just not this one. Again, this is my response to the product. It may be fine for anyone else.

I purchased this product a while ago from a different store and returned it after my skin became irritated. I wanted to give it another try after finding a Clinique face soap that works wonders. This time around, I love the results.

I use this lotion for more than a year and I really like it. It makes my face feel so good after cleaning because water in my city makes skin very dry, despite the fact that I use Clinique facial soap for washing. I will keep purchasing it!

I can feel a difference when using the toner. it doesn't take much so it lasts a while. my only suggestion is having some kind of a better distribute. it'd be nice if it had where you could squrt a little bit on a cotton ball.
It doesn't work nor does it work with other products I plan to implement.

I have flaky skin from trentinoin and this has been perfect for smoothing and removing flakes before skincare/makeup. I appreciate how gentle and effective it is, there's no burning or sensitivity after using twice a day. Would definitely recommend this as an exfoliator for someone with super dry/sensitive skin.

Absolutely great for mature, drying skin. I am middle aged and decided to try the 1.0 Clarifying Lotion from Clinique again. When I was younger I always used number 3 and then 2. And then I stopped using it. But my mature skin still needs the cell turnover that creates bright and soft looking skin. And this alcohol free version is fantastic. It gives my skin a very clean look and after 2 weeks of once daily use I looked younger. Yeah!! Twice a week I replace it with the Clarifying do-over peel. That's another great product to promote cell turnover and create beautiful skin.
Had given up on toners because of dry sensitive skin until I found this. Have been using several months and I find it very gentle..no tingle or dry patches.

avis.titre: I would recommend this to anybody!
avis.texte: I love this product. I don't have to do much with it. I have combination skin but mostly Dry, and this has renewed my skin and it looks so pretty. I have only been using it a week but so far I love it and it will be apart of my daily until something better comes up.
Love love love My skin feels tights and moisturized, not dry or greasy and so fresh. Notice a difference in skin texture too and brightness!

avis.titre: Would definitely buy again and again!!
avis.texte: For a long time I was scared to incorporate an exfoliant into my routine, because I have VERY dry, flaky, and super sensitive skin. My skin has gotten to the point that it was screaming it needs help exfoliating. The Clinique consultant at Ulta recommended me this product, and with it being 50% off at the time I decided to give it a go. It's amazing! It's SUPER gentle, non-drying, and doesn't make my skin feel right afterwards at all. No burning whatsoever, it just feels like water honestly. My skin feels super soft after using and looks glowing. I should have bought both bottles! Highly recommend for all my super dry and sensitive skin girlies.

I used the mild clarifying lotion for years back to when it was called the aloe based clarifier. This product is not even close to that product. Instead of camping my rosacea it causes it to flare up. It also causes patches of dryness on my face. Please bring back the old product and stop trying to pass this one off as the replacement.

I've been using Clinique toner 1 for years but this is the first time trying this version. I love it. Doesn't dry my super dry skin and has a slight exfoliating property to it. My skin feels and looks good after using. I will be buying this product from now on.

avis.titre: I would buy thus product again.
avis.texte: I'm allergic to alot of products but clinque haas never failed me

avis.titre: I will definitely purchase again when needed!
avis.texte: A big thank you to Rose Mary the consultant in Ulta of Florence SC.. She was absolutely the best.. Everything that she selected for me to try was perfect.. The clarifying Lotion is a great asset to my skincare routine.

avis.titre: I've used this product for years and will continue to do so.
avis.texte: I was able to use my store coupon with the help of the manager abd would highly recommend the Mansfield store!

I LOVE this mild yet effective toner. I only use it nightly and I have been seen results within a week. My pores are refined, my skin is less dry and sensitive and my tone is more even. I have always exfoliated my skin (chemical exfoliators) but this gives me the best results ever with NO irritation whatsoever.The formula is amazing and I can't believe this product doesn't get enough praise. In my opinion, it's perfect.

I was using Clarifying toner 2. which is fine at night. In the morning I shave my face and if using the 2 it's was to strong and found Clarifying in 1.0 ( no alcohol ) it's excellent and if you have sensitive skin it's perfect. Comes in the large bottle but it's a lot of product. I will finish up my 2 and use the 1.0 for my routine for night and morning.

avis.titre: Changed my skin within a week
avis.texte: I needed something for sensitive skin that was not too harsh so I tried this. I was shocked at how much dirt came off of my skin even without makeup on. I use it in the morning and at bedtime. Many of my dark spots from the sun have disappeared and my skin appears smoother. I've been using it for about a month.
Not for me. This actually caused irritation and breakouts. Will be ordering reg clarifying lotion.

I love this toner! I'm 59 w/combo skin that is getting drier & drier. I was experiencing horrible breakouts due to stress and moving to to a much drier climate. Sooo I turned to Clinique! Wow! My face cleared up & looks great. This toner is very effective & gentle. I use it twice a day without fail along with my other Clinique products. Thanks, Clinique! I will be a lifetime customer!
I love this product it really helps with the flaking I have on my forehead
I use this after I use the clinque 2 and 1 exfoliating face wash. Are the clinque 7 day scrub, this is one of my holy grails I love it. It really cleans in exfoliate your face!

This exfoliating toner is great. It's very gentle and soothing but still exfoliates. It never irritates skin, makes skin burn/tingle or turn red. It's great for sensitive skin types who can't tolerate alcohol in a product.

This is a great gentle exfoliating toner with 1% salicylic acid. It's great for those looking to address mild texture issues, and provides light hydration. I prefer this to their other toner/lotions since it is alcohol free and isn't as harsh on my sensitive, acne-prone skin. The bottle is also very large and lasts me at least 2 months when used twice daily.

It was okay - I think it may be making me break out a little, but I'm not entirely sure. It does seem to help remove dead skin from drier areas. It definitely doesn't sting, and it doesn't cause any immediate bad reactions, which I was worried about because of how sensitive my skin usually is, so that was good. Just not sure that it's really doing anything aside from giving me another step in my routine.

I have combination skin and began the 3 step system years ago using the number 3 Clarifying lotion. After a couple of weeks I found it to be too harsh for my skin. I visited my local Clinique counter and shared my concerns and I was advised to try the 1.0 Clarifying lotion. What a difference! I love this clarifying lotion because it's gentle but effective. It leaves my skin clean and glowing without any harshness. Great product. I highly recommend for sensitive skin.

avis.titre: All I can say is WOW!
avis.texte: So I've tried ALL of Clinique's Clarifying Lotions and finally gave up because EVERY one of them burned my face. I have super sensitive skin. I did an online chat consultation and the represenitve's name was Lexie. I originally did a chat to make sure I was using all of my products in the right order as I use more than 3 (I use 8) not all twice a day. Anyway, she asked me if I use a calrifying lotion and I told her the problem I had when I tried all of the different formulas. She mentioned this one. She said it doesn't have alcohol in it and it would be best for me. I went to Ulta and got it that day. All I can say is WOW what a nice surprise! It doesn't burn my face or dry it out! It is very gentle. I'm so glad I took her advice and got it. Now my skin care routine is the regular 3 step plus my other treatments. This is now a staple for me. I couldn't be more happier!
I didn't mind this product but I have never used a toner before and I it made my skin red after using it

I love this! It's great for keeping skin clear, but isn't drying. Love that it doesn't have alcohol in it. Works much better for my dry/combination winter skin than the formulation with alcohol, like the 2 or 3. It layers really nicely under the Dramatically Different Moisturizing Lotion for hydration, and I also like the exfoliation it provides too!
I was looking for an alcohol free toner. This delivered. Does not irritate my skin and feels great to apply!
I love how gentle it is on the skin, yet still help the skin to glow! Highly recommend it to anyone with sensitive skins.

avis.titre: I've been using this for several years
avis.texte: I have very sensitive skin but still need to exfoliate. This works well for both.

I'm one of the few people who didn't love -- and could not tolerate -- the old Mild Clarifying Lotion and I'm glad to have this alcohol-free option. It works very well for my dry-combination skin! I've noticed, though, that it is not compatible with certain moisturizers and sunscreens. I suspect it may leave a slight film behind that causes some products to pill.

My skin doesn't react to this product except in a good way. The other clarifying lotions irritate my skin. This is alcohol free yet has Salicylic Acid to help with my oily sensitive skin. No breakouts or redness just calm happy skin. Highly recommend to everyone who experiences issues with sensitive skin!

As a teenager I was always sold the wrong toner- either a 3 or 4- just because of some hormonal acne and shiny T-zone. I would be more irritated and always had acne come back. The biggest mistake they make at clinique is sell you the set- just because you are combination does mean you can use the Dramatically Different yellow moisturizer for example and just becasue you have some shine does not mean you should got for a 3 or 4. Now at 40 I am a clear jelly lotion user and every other day I use the "Smart" day (and I love the "smart" night- it is instantly healing overnight to help remove acne scars beleive it or not). I have used some Clarifying 2 samples in my regiment- By the way I use the Mild Cleanser and I used to be a toner 3 and 4 customer. Go Figure!! Now that I know my acne is hormonal and I have changed to be more combination dry, I love this toner after Mild cleanser (and with the jelly and occasional smart day or energy city block for summer.) I created my own regimen which works for me. And this 1.0 has no alcohol! That was the main reason I bought it in the first place as I could not understand how 2 still burns me at combination skin! The dramatically different yellow moisturizers- even the gel- leave me clogged and greasy- go figure I am a 1.0 user who cannot use the yellow moisturizes. I think they need to stop selling the grouped regimens and look at what works for you!!

I never used the old version so I'm unable to compare, but I've used this in combo with the other clarifying lotion numbers and find that it helps my skin not dry out especially in the colder months. I'd recommend trying.

I've tried all of Clinique's clarfying lotions and this one is by far the best if you sensitive skin. The other ones made me burn and made certain areas of my face very red and irritated. This one keeps my skin fresh feeling and calm. This lotion has salicylic acid in it to help with controlling my oily areas too.

This has become my go-to. If feels lovely — cool, soothing, slightly moisturizing. It has a small amount of BHA which really does help keep my pores clear, and I really do notice the difference if I don't use it for a while. In the evening I follow it up with Moisture Surge and/or Moisture Surge Intense depending on how my skin is feeling that day, but, in the a.m., I find that it's enough just with my spf. It does leave a shine to my skin, but my skin is still dry to the touch. I think it's rather pretty that way. I had tried the previous formulation years ago and never really liked it, but I love this one!

I suffer from dry, sensitive skin and have rosacea. It is so hard for me to try new products because of the fear of a reaction. I was already using the Redness Solutions line (the only products I have found I can use without irritation) but my skin was still so dry. I decided to try this out fully expecting to have a reaction. Not only did I not have a negative reaction to it, but I noticed an improvement in my skin after just a few uses. My skin is no longer dry looking and the texture has improved dramatically!!
kudos and commendation: many thanks and applause to associate "sabrina a." who was so very helpful!
No toner I've tried has ever has reduced the redness, or dryness, of my skin the way this did! I'm hooked.

I have very dry, very sensitive fair skin and this is great product for my skin. There is no burning (I used to use the same Clinique Product but the 2.0 and it burned my skin whenever I used it). It does have a bit of a soapy texture IF you use too much of it. So a little goes a long way. Overall it's a gentle, effective cleanser and will be using this one from now on.

avis.titre: I love this ALCOHOL FREE toner
avis.texte: Alcohol dries out the skin and is not good for acne. This toner is perfect, cleanses the extra dirt and oil off my face before I apply my moisturizer. I've been using this toner for two years now.
Love how cooling and soothing it feels on my sensitive redness prone skin. I should've started using Clinique years ago but so glad to have it now.

avis.titre: Perfect for really, really sensitive skin.
avis.texte: My daughter uses a prescription acne medication and this is gentle enough to be part of her skincare routine.

I can not love this enough! I have very sensitive skin that can get red and this product is amazing. Leaves my skin feeling clean with no stinging or harshness and best of all...no redness!!! I have not had a problem with it drying out of my skin (I have a tendency for oil combo skin), but I do use a moisturizer after using this. Love Clinique products for skin care...it's just finding what combo works for you!

I have oily combination skin and I used to use Clarifying Lotion 3 but I recently switched to the 1.0 since I wanted a toner/exfoliant that was alcohol-free. I thought it was doing nothing since my skin didn't have that squeaky clean feel as it used to with the 3. It felt like water. But after a while, I saw that the 1.0 does its job as an exfoliant and sloughs off dead skin just as well as the 3 without the sting. I feel safer using this since it's milder and my skin feels super smooth after it has been absorbed. If you're used to the ones with alcohol, this may take some getting used to but it's so much better in the long run. Highly recommended.
Purchased this as a gift to my teenage daughter,she has been using this for the past 3-4 years.

I am not sure about the negative reviews for this product. However, my experience has been great. This does not cause dryness of my skin. It does not burn, nor sting. It actually gives my skin a healthy glow. I can see a positive difference in my pores as well. My skin looks more even and smooth.
NO dye, NO alcohol!! One of the only Clinique items I can use due to Clinique using so much dye in their skincare. Love this!

What happened to this product? I used to buy it from time to time to remove leftover makeup and refresh my complexion. It had a low level of salicylic acid in that was gentle and soothing to my skin. This new version made my skin flush bright red and it stings for hours after using it. I've tried it three times now and I'm about to throw in the towel on it. Clinique had a great product in its original iteration. I wish Clinique had left well enough alone

I tried the clarifying lotion 1 for dry combination and it made red splotches all over my face and they wouldn't go away for hours after I used it. I have dry/Combination and very sensitive skin. This one made my face feel clean and I didn't have any negative reaction to it if you have sensitive skin try this one!

avis.titre: Sensitive skins, this is your thing!
avis.texte: I have combination skin, and was started on a 1 level toner, and it left my face red and hives under my eyes. I went back to the counter and the lady recomended i used the 1.0. Total game changer! I love useing claryfing lotion in the morning, specialy on the neck area, to remove dirt and oil, and this one does the trick, even if its super light. Its kind of like a soapy feeling, but leaves the skin tingling very nicely.

I have been struggling with my changing skin. The Pep Start scrub made a big difference, but my skin still felt rough despite use of intensive moisturizer including argan oil. I turned to this. Within a few days, my skin was soft again. I wear foundation—because of rosacea unevenness—in either liquid or powder form with better results. I will go read the negative reviews of this product next, but my experience has been completely positive.

I've been using the type 2 exfoliating lotion for a long time. I have typically dry skin but I get oil in my t-zone. I do think the type 2 was good for me when I was younger but my skin is getting more dry as time goes on it seems. This is a good alcohol-free alternative. It doesn't have the same tingling sensation but it still wipes the dirt off. My skin feels really moisturized afterwards, even before putting my moisturizer on.

avis.titre: The old formula was a million times better!
avis.texte: I'm not happy with this clarifying lotion at all! It doesn't even come close to the original mild clarifying lotion! It's sticky, it burns and leaves a film on the skin! Why change or fix a product that was never broken? Truly a disappointment

A little goes a long way with this product! It goes on light and dries quickly. It's not sticky and it doesn't burn at all. I was surprised at the dirt I was able to get off of my "clean" face. It does not dry out my skin at all. This is a must have!

I wanted to try this because I have very sensitive skin. I think I live at my Dermatologist Office with breaking out into rashes. This Toner works really great. And the best thing I didn't break out with a rash. The only thing I would change is to make a bigger bottle so you can put the pump application top on there. I just feel like I'm wasting some of it by turning it upside down to put it on the Cotton Ball. I think this a great toner for Sensitive Skin and for Teenagers starting there Daily Beauty Regimen. Thanks you Clinique for creating another wonderful Beauty Product. I'm over 45 and have only Clinique Products.

avis.titre: What a difference no alcohol makes!
avis.texte: I couldn't get the Clinique Clarifying 1.0 once and got the 1 instead (with alcohol). This is so much better. Next time I will wait for it. Less drying. Just better for my dry, sensitive skin.

I did not realize how dirty my skin was until I started using this product! I see less black heads, and ai have new skin growth and more even skin tone. It also has very little smell and does not dry my face out.
I was using Mild Clarifying Lotion before it was taken out of production and this is the best one that can replace it. I don't like lotions that have alcohol in them

avis.titre: I've used this before and I love it
avis.texte: First of all the 13 oz is a big bottle , And it does last more than 2 months. At first when I put it on , it does kind of burns but just a little and it goes away quickly . This product does work for me , my skin very sensitive and dry, and the alcohol version just dries my skin. I like how it smells, it reminds me of a botanical scent but it's not strong or overpowering. This step does make a difference , it does take away dead skin cells, and over time it improves your overall skin. I would recommend this product

If been using this for a few months now I like how it calms my redness down on my face and it doesn't leave a filmy residue I will be sticking with this one forever I can't use anything with alcohol in it it does harm to my skin so this one is a must to have no alcohol
I much prefer over this version over the exfoliator with alcohol. This product doesn't dry out my skin at all.
My skin is combination but sensitive. This light exfoliator is perfect for me.

I can't use a toner with alcohol because it dries me out and I don't even have dry skin. I was using Lancôme's for years and this is just as good and it's cheaper. I also feel it lasts for a long time. I'm so glad Clinique came out with this.
This product is one of the few that doesn't irritate my skin. My skin is dry and I have rosacea. I use it at night after washing my face and before applying a serum.

I strayed form Clinique because my skin was looking. Great and wanted to see if I could find something that would slow aging. I ended up with perioral dermatitis - which is horribly ugly and difficult to hide. I knew I had to go back to my regular Clinique regime. Poof- back on track. You want an exfoliation and want to do it safely without complication- get a Clinique regime on board.

I bought this to try something new, I have sensitive skin and rosacea. This toner is gentle and non-irritating, alcohol free. Have been using for one week, every morning and night, so far so good. The only thing I don't like is the scent, but it goes away quickly. I normally use the Mario Badechu Aloe Vera toner, which is wonderful.

avis.titre: Finally a product line that works for ppl with rosacea.
avis.texte: I came across this product because of a beauty consultant with Clinique who took the time to explain to me why my (prestige) moisture products where not giving me my desired results, in fact had ill effects. I had gotten out of a cleansing routine and simply just wash face morning and night as I don't wear much make up and got lazy I guess. The product is giving me better results than I'd hoped and will also buy other products in this line all due to the great consultant at Vancouver Mall Ulta.. Wish I knew her name but she is a regular there she say.
I use this after I wash my face and before I put on the Clinique moisturizer that has a probiotics. My skin hasn't looked this good in years!
I wouldn't be without this, I buy the larger size for economy then decant into mini bottle which fits neatly in my bathroom cabinet

With so much on the market it's hard to narrow down what you should buy. I'm happy with this product because it works so good on my skin it exfoliates my skin like no other. I prefer to use mine at night before bed and the next morning my skin is so soft and glowing. I've tried other toners including Dior but this one is the best. Although it says it's for dry skin I have combination skin and it works really good!

I love this toner i have used many toners and always go back to this one i don't have dry skin but this product works wonders i wear makeup daily and after i wash this removes everything left behind it does clarify and does leave you sticky afterwards but you must allow it to dry fully before applying anything else!! my pores have shrunk dramatically and i have close to no breakouts if you use this product daily it does work

Unlike the beloved Mild Clarifying Lotion, this liquid does not give my skin a fresh, tingly, clean feeling. It feels like I am dabbing a greasy liquid over my skin. When it drives, it leaves a sticky film, and it turns my cheeks and chin red. I hate it. I wish the wonderful Mild Clarifying Lotion were still available.

I've stayed away from Clinique line since highschool. But recently my Kate Somerville alcohol free toner which I love has been discontinued and I needed to find another alcohol free fragrance free toner. I got this and I'm seeing results. It cleans and refreshed your skin, doesn't make it feel tight. I'm in love with the toner. If you have sensitive skin, try this. You can't beat the price for the amount you get either.

avis.titre: The Perfect Exfoliator for sensitive skin
avis.texte: I've used the previous version and I personally prefer this! The former left a sticky film while this one just feels clean. I even have rosacea and my skin loves this! I've never had a problem and never plan to be without it!
I love this clarifying lotion. I am beginning to start with rosacea as I age. This lotion works to clear my skin without the redness. I consider this lotion odorless. Wish it came in the jumbo pump.

I just recently got this and I can't believe how much of a difference it's made already. I have very dry skin that flakes and my skincare products and makeup just seemed to pill no matter what, until I started using this in conjunction with the extra mild cleanser and the original lotion, but I think this in particular is what's made such a difference. I've only used this four or five times so far and the flaking around my nose is almost completely gone and I barely notice any pilling either. I've never used a skincare product that has made such an improvement in my skin and it's only been less than a week, I am beyond amazed with these products.
I use this clarifying lotion in the morning and then again at night to get rid of excess makeup. It is not harsh for my skin.

I normally use the Clarifying Lotion #2 & love it. However, my skin has been drier than normal due to the colder weather. The Clinque consultant recommended Clarifying Lotion 1.0. I was hesitant at first. She assured me that if I did not like it I could return it & I know this to be true of Ulta. I'm so happy I purchased this product!! My skin loves it! It feels so clean, soft & refreshed without drying me out. What a wonderful product!! Thank you so much Clinque! :)

avis.titre: Still using it but the old one was better
avis.texte: Like many other reviewers on here, I miss the old mild clarifying lotion. This is definitely stronger and more drying and makes my skin a little tight feeling in winter. I feel like I need more/stronger moisturizer with it.

This stuff is liquid gold in a bottle! I've had issues with my skin my entire life. I eat super clean and drink gallons of water, along with using super reputable good-quality skin care products, and the tone and texture of my skin is still horrible, and my pores are H U G E. Not to mention my skin is super reactive and sensitive. I finally stopped using Dermalogica for a bit to try this more affordable brand, and lemme tell ya. It's been 4-6 days and my skin already feels soooo soft and looks glowy and healthy. Granted, I've combined it with other Clinique products, but I can actually physically SEE the dirt and dead skin cells coming off when I use this. Must have, will always keep as part of my skincare routine.

Clarifying Lotion 1.0 is amazing. It is the first clarifying lotion that Clinique has made that doesn't hurt me. All of the others (including the discontinued "Mild" lotion) caused my skin to burn and turn bright red. This one manages both to be effective and to be gentle enough that I can even run it over my eyelids. It was surprisingly soothing when I had some eczema. Plus, the witch hazel in it smells very calming. I hope this product stays around for a long time (forever would work for me).

avis.titre: Great exfoliator for sensitive dry skin
avis.texte: I hesitated to buy this as there are so many bad reviews about this toner. Turns out that I like this. My skin desperately needed an exfoliator and all these scrubs, alcoholic toners, masks and oil cleansers did nothing to remove the little amount of foundation that ended up in my pores and neither did it remove my dead skin cells. So after awhile my face make up did not look so fresh, it really just looked dry and splotchy. Then I started this Clinique 1.0 toner and now my face looks and feels super clean and it makes my moisturizer work better and makes my make-up look a lot better. I use this only at night as I do need see or feel the need to over clean/over dry my skin in the morning by using this again. On a different note I am so glad that Ulta is selling Clinique!!!

This clarifying lotion was so drying for my skin it created wrinkles on my face that I had never seen before. Needless to say that I will not continue to use this. Clinique needs to do better than that. As this exfoliator should really be a part of my daily facial cleansing routine. I now need to go to another brand to look for something similar.

I got this because the number two clarifying lotion was too harsh for me. But I feel like this one is not really doing anything for my skin. Nothing really special here. It does make my skin feel clean and that's about it.
Used 2x's per day as directed and nothing. Just feels sticky.

I bought this product since it was recommended for sensitive skin. After 1 day of use red irritated skin and broke out pimples and itchy patches. Wish I could have bought a sample size before I spent the $ careful if you are sensitive!

avis.titre: Love it for my redness skin
avis.texte: Love it for my redness skin. Is lovely not to feel alcohol in this product. the oher ones dry my skin. Love this 1.0 < 3

I absolutely love the product. Having rosacea makes it difficult to find the right kind of products for your face. This stuff is incredible and doesn't irritate my skin at all. I use it twice a day and my skin has never looked better. It's affordable for the amount you get.

Have had no negative skin reactions. Combined with the extra-gentle foaming face wash daily and the sonic foaming cleanser several times a week, my skin is smooth and blackheads are shrinking. I use DD lotion as well. The only reason I gave it a 4 instead of 5 is that just the fumes do tend to irritate the unbelievably sensitive skin of my lips and inside my mouth.
It doesn't have alcohol, I usually use 2, but when I have some trouble on my skin or when I have period, I used this one. Also I recommend after peeling as well.
